fields.title: Choose an isolation model
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Three deals in negotiation. For each, state what model is needed and what must be sold separately.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: Chain of 40 stores, requires data storage in Russia and confirmation of isolation from competitors
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: Chain of 12 stores, wants custom warehouse codes and Saturday update windows
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: First — database per tenant, residency is achievable only this way; sold as enterprise tier. Second — shared schema, otherwise economics don't work. Third — shared schema plus extension table for warehouse codes; Saturday update windows in a shared schema are unachievable, this must be stated honestly and either refused or spun out as well. General rule: customer requirement translates to isolation model, model translates to price line.
